description: Every source agency: name, homepage, terms URL, required notice, and status (live, paused, hand entry, or not collected), with any series the agency itself is late with. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.
name: list_sources
title: Sources, terms and notices
